fieldValues.title: RFC-009 Change A: Add rootTypeRefs to DocumentView
fieldValues.proposed_change:
Add optional rootTypeRefs?: ExactTypeRef[] to DocumentView. When set, the DocumentView applies to Containers whose typing anchor (Container.anchorInstanceId; RFC-009 Rev 6/srs#446) has a typeId/typeVersion matching any ExactTypeRef entry. Pre-#446 repositories resolve the anchor via the transitional rootInstanceIds[0] fallback. ExactTypeRef requires both typeId (UUID) and typeVersion (integer >= 1). Multi-entry OR semantics. Soft-deprecates containerType to a back-compat hint. Conformance rules I-63, I-145.

**Amended by RFC-043 (effective at dataModelRevision 8).** The `rootInstanceIds[0]` fallback is withdrawn; the typing anchor is always `Container.anchorInstanceId`, which must equal an entry `instanceId` in `memberInstanceIds` ([R3], [R4], [R19]). (Prior text, in force until a corpus is at revision 8: the statement above.)
fieldValues.rationale: UUID-based anchoring replaces fragile containerType string join. ExactTypeRef is version-exact because the DocumentView-to-Container match is a package-validation-time claim requiring both typeId and typeVersion to resolve.
